atoms.text: Aurelia will go to boarding school next year because her parents have to go on business trips more regularly. They suggested Kensington Boarding School. Aurelia wants to learn more about that school now, to decide whether she wants to go there or not. Therefore, she visits the school website. Can you navigate through the website and help her find answers to her questions?

hint.text:
business trip – Geschäftsreise
to navigate – navigieren
to suggest – vorschlagen

atoms.a: Aurelia is thirteen years old. How old are the pupils that go to Kensington Boarding school?
b: ++They are older than twelve years old.
They are older than eighteen years old.
They are younger than twelve years old.

atoms.a: How can Aurelia contact her new school?
b: She can write them a letter.
She can visit them every weekend.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die passende Stelle in der Navigationsleiste der Website.

atoms.a: Aurelia wants to learn more about the extracurricular activities of her new school.

instruction.text: Lies dir den Text durch und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.a: Aurelia was in the drama club at her old school. Is there a drama club at KBS?
Aurelia loves to spend time at the seaside. Which clubs does her school offer by the sea?
How many clubs does a boarder at KBS have to join each term?

instruction.text: Tippe auf die passende Stelle in der Navigationsleiste der Website.

atoms.a: Now Aurelia wants to find out more about where she is going to sleep at KBS.

instruction.text: Lies dir den Text durch und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

b: ++Boys and girls can go to KBS.
Only girls can go to KBS.

atoms.a: What does a dorm at KBS offer?
At home Aurelia doesn't have to share her room. With how many other pupils does she have to share her room at the dorm?

instruction.text: Tippe auf die passende Stelle in der Navigationsleiste der Website.

atoms.a: Aurelia is curious about what happened at KBS recently.

hint.text: You can find the information on the news section of the school website.
